title: Hearty Juicy Italian Pistachio Suppli
description: A jammy and juicy Italian dish featuring pistachio, tempered chocolate, and no onion or garlic, formed into suppli and cooked in a tagine pot.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the pistachio meal, parmesan cheese, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Add the melted tempered chocolate to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Add the tomato sauce to the bowl and mix until a thick paste forms.
Add the beaten eggs to the bowl and mix until the mixture is smooth and sticky.
Add the breadcrumbs to the bowl and mix until the mixture is well coated.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small suppli shapes.
Place the suppli in a tagine pot and drizzle with olive oil.
Cover the tagine pot with a lid and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the lid and bake for an additional 10 minutes, or until the suppli are golden brown.
